dI0 - sveda iti | svidyate~aneneti vyutpattyA svedo~agniH, tasya vidhiH karmacAturI | caturvidhatvamAha - ekastApasaMj~jaH svedaH| dvitIyastUShmAsaMj~jaH| tRutIya upanAhaH upanAho nibandhanamiti pralepena | asya BedaH sAlvaNa iti | caturtho dravasveda iti | eteShAM lakShaNaM boddhavyaM anyatrApyuktaM ca 'kShAmaHsaikatapArShNikAsyavasanaiH svedo~athavAMgArakairlepairvAtaharaiH sahAmlalavaNaiH snehaiH suKomlairBavet | evaM taptapayombuvAtaSamanakvAthAdisekAdiBistaptaistoyaniShecanAhatamahAbAShpaiH sitAdyaiH kramA’diti | eShveva caturShu yathAkramaM carakoktasaMkarasvedAdyavarodhaH | SaMkarAdisvedA yathA 'SaMkaraH prastaro nADI pariSheko~avagAhanaM | jetAkoShmaGanaH karShaH kuTI BUH kumBireva ca | kUpo dolaka ityete svedayanti trayodaSa iti#foot@SaMkaraH suKakaraH | tasyABidhAnamagre praSastatvAt | eteShAM svedAnAM vaidyAnAM vij~jAnArthaM svarUpamuktaM carake - ‘ tatra vastrAntaritaiH piNDairyathoktairupasvedanaM Sa~gkarasveda' iti | tasyoShmasvede~antarBAvaH | vastrAntaritatvamavastrAntaritatva~jca sukumArAsukumAraviShayaM j~jeyam | prastaramAha - ‘ SUka-Simbi-dhAnya-pulAkAnAM , veSavAra-pAyasa-kRuSaro-tkarikAdInAM vA prastare kauSeyA-~avikottarapracCade vA, pa~jcA~ggulorubukAdInAM vA , kauSeyAvikottarArkapatrapracCanne vA svaByaktagAtrasya SayAnasyopasvedanaM prastarasvedanaM iti vidyAt ’ | ayaM coShmasveda eva | SUka-Simbi-dhAnya-pulAkAnAmiti BAvaH | anyatrApyuktaM - ‘ pulAkamatrametAvaddravyANAmiha ShaTSatam | svabuddhyaiva sahasrANi koTIrvA samprakalpayet' iti | athavA ‘pulAka' SabdaH svinnavacanaH , SUkaSimbidhAnyAnAM svinnAnAM prastare ityarthaH | anye tu pulAkA gavedhukAkArA deSAntare prasiddhAH | iti vyAKyAnayanti | tadayuktaM SUkaSimbidhAnyeShvevAntarBAvAt | tAsAM ca na svedavattAyogyatA pratipattuM SakyA , doShaviSeShAharaNAt | kauSeyAvikottarapracCannadeSe-kauSeyAvikAByAM vA upari pracCanne prastare ityarthaH | uttaracCadagrahaNAdadhastAdapi pracCado~astIti gamyate | iti prastarasvedaH ||2||
 nADIsvedamAha - ‘ svedanadravyANAM pUrvoktAnAM mUlapatraPalaBa~ggAdInAM mRugaSakunipiSitaSirasAdInAm uShNasvaBAvAnAM yathA~amlalavaNaM snehopahitAnAM mUtrAdInAM kumByAM voShmamanu dhamantyAmutkvathitAnAM nADyA vaMSadalakara~jjArkapatrANAmanyatamakRutayA gajAgrahastasaMsthAnayA vyAyAmadIrGayA vyAyAmArdhadIrGayA vA svAyAmacaturBAgAShTaBAgamUlAgrapariNAhasrotasA sarvato vAtaharapatrasaMvRutacCidrayA dvistrirvA vinamitayA vAtaharasnehAByaktagAtrasya voShmamupAharet , bAShpo~ahyanRujugAmI vihitacaNDavegastvacamavidahan suKaM svedayatIti nADIsvedaH ’ | Ba~ggAH pallavAH | svAyAmacaturBAgAShTaBAgamUlAgra-pariNAhasrotaseti | vyAyAmadIrGayA vyAyAmArdhadIrGayA ceti | pramANaniyame ko hetuH ? brUmaH – vyAdhyAturabalApekShayA , uttamabalavyAdhAvAture ca vyAyAmadIrGA karttavyA , madhyabalaM hi vyAdhimAturaM cAvekShyamANena vyAyAmAdhyardhadIrGayA dUragatvena vihitacaNDavegatA BAvayet iti | iti nADIsvedaH bAShpasvede~antarBUtaH ||3||
pariShekasvedamAha - ‘ vAtikottaravAtikAnAM punarmUlaPalAdInAmutkvAthaiH suKoShNaiH kumBIrvarShaNikAH praNADIrvA pUrayitvA yathArthasiddhasnehAByaktagAtravastrAvacCannaM pariShecayet iti pariShekasvedaH' dravasvede~antarBUtaH | iti pariShekasvedaH ||4||
avagAhasvedamAha - ‘ vAtaharotkvAthakShIraGRutapiSitarasonasalilakoShTakAvagAhastu yathokta evAvagAho j~jeyaH' | utkvAthairiti utkRuShTakvAthairityarthaH | dravyAccaturguNaM jalaM datvA caturBAgAvaSiShTaH kRuta utkRuShTaH kvAtho Bavati ayaM dravasvedaH | ityavagAhasvedaH | 
jetAkasvedamAha – atha jetAkaM cikIrShurBUmiM parIkShyeta – tatra pUrvasyAM diSi uttarasyAM vA guNavati praSastaBUmiBAge deSe kRuShmamRuttike suvarNavarNamRuttike vA nadIparivApaH vApIpuShkariNyAdInAM jalASayAnAmanyatamasya kUle dakShiNe paScime vA sutIrthe samaviBaktaBUmiBAgadeSe saptAShTau vA~aratnIH parikramodakAn prA~gmuKoda~gmuKaM vA~aBimuKatIrthaM vA kUTAgAraM kArayet | utsedhavistArasampannaM anekavAtAyanamasya kUTAgArasyAntaH samantato~aBivistArotsedhAM piDikAM kArayet AkapATAt | madhye cAsya kUTAgArasya catuHkiShkumAtraM dvipuruShapramANaM mRuNmayaM kandukasaMsthAnaM bahusUkShmacCidrama~ggArakoShTakastamBaM sapidhAnaM kArayet | taM ca KAdirANAmASvakarNikAnAM vA kAShThAnAM pUrayitvA dIpayet | sa yadA jAnIyAt dagdhAni kAShThAni vigatadhUmAni avataptaM kevalamagninA tadagnigRuhaM svedayogyena yoShmaNA yuktamiti | tatra cainaM vAtaharABya~ggAByaktagAtraM vastrAcCannaM praveSayet | praveSayaMScAnuSiShyet - ‘ saumya ! praviSArogyakalyANAya vA ’ iti praviSya cainAM piNDikAmadhiruhya pArSvAByAM yathAsuKaM SayIthAH | na ca te svedamUrCAparItenA~api satA piNDikaiShA prayoktavyA AprANocCvAsAt | BraSyamAno hi yataH piNDikAvaSAt dvAramavadhiM gacCan svedamUrCAparItatayA sadyaH prANAn jahyAt , tasmAt piNDikAM na katha~jcana mu~jcethAH | sa yadA jAnIyAdvigatABiShyandamAtmAnaM samyak prastutasvedapicCaM sarvasrotovinirmuktaM laGuBUtamapagataM vibandhastamBagauravasuptivedanamiti | tatastAM piTikAmanusaran dvAraM prapadyeta niShkramya ca na sahasA cakShuShoH paripAlanArthaM SItodakamanupraviSet | vyapagatasaMtApaklamaH sumuhUrtAt suKoShNena vAriNA yathAnyAyaM pariShikto~aSnIyAt ’ iti jetAkaH | ayaM cAgArakoShTastamBo jetAka ucyate ‘BUgRuheShu sa jetAkeShu ’ iti vacanAt | taM KAdirANAmASvakarNikAnAM vA kAShThAnAM pUrayitvA dIpayet | iti jetAkasvedaH sa UShmasvedAntarBUtaH | iti jetAkasvedaH ||6||
athASmaGanasvedamAha - ‘ Sayanasya pramANenA~aSmamayIM SilAM tApayitvA~anilaGnaistu dAruBiH sampradIpitaiH vyapohya sarvAna~ggArAn prokShya coShNavAriNA SilAmatha kurvIta kauSeyA~avikasaMstarAm , kauSeyaprAvArAdyaiH susaMvRuttaH ityukto~aSmaGanasvedaH ’ iti ||
GanAM sthUlAM | nanu SilA yA sA~aSmamayyeva punaraSmamayImiti viSeShaNamanarthakam ? ucyate – sannahyArthAntarANi samAnaSabdABihitAni tenASmaSabdaH kAThinye vartate iti | kaucavo mRugaromamayIralikA, ajinaM kRuShNamRugacarma, kauSeyaM traSaraM prAvAraH paTTikA AdigrahaNAtkambalorNAdInAM grahaNam | iti aSmaGanasvedaH, tApasvede~antarBUtaH | ityaSmaGanasvedaH ||7||
atha karpUsvedaH pracakShyate - ‘ KAnayecCayanasyAdhaH karpUsthAnaviBAgavit | dIptairvidhUmaira~ggAraistAM karpUM pUrayennaraH | tatropariShTAcCayane svapan svidyati nA suKam ’ iti karpUsveda UShmasvedaBedaH | iti karpUsvedaH ||8||
atha kuTIsvedamAha - ‘ anatyutsedhavistarAM vRuttAkArAmalocanAm | GanamitiM kuTiM kRutvA kuShThAdyaiH sampralepayet | kuTImadhye BiShak SayyAM svAstIrNAM copakalpayet | prAvArAjinakauSeyakuthakambalagauNakaiH | hasantikABira~ggArapUrNABistAM ca sarvataH | Aroheta parIvAryAByaktaH svidyati nA suKam ’ iti || parivArya pariveShTya | iti kuTIsvede svedaBedaH | iti kuTIsvedaH ||9||
BUsvedamAha - ‘ya evASmaGanasvede vidhirBUmau sa eva tu | praSastAyAM nivAtAyAM samAyAmupadiSyate’ iti | ayamapyuShNasvedaBedaH | iti BUsvedaH ||10||
atha kumBIsvedamAha – kumBIM vAtaharakvAthapUrNAM BUmau niKAnayet | ardhamAtraM triBAgaM vA SayanaM tatra copari || sthApayedAsanaM vA~api nAtisAndraparicCadam | atha kuMByAM BiShak dadyAtsutaptAnAyaso guDAn || pAShANAn voShmaNA tena tatsthaH svidyati nA suKam | suvRuttA~ggaH svaByaktaH snehairanilanASanaiH || athavApyUShmaNA tena tatsthaH svidyati pUrvavat ’ iti | ayamapyUShmasvedAntarBUtaH | iti kumBIsvedaH | 
kUpasvedamAha - ‘ kUpaM SayanavistAraM dviguNaM vApi vaidyataH | deSe nivAte Sakte ca sumRuShTaM kArayettataH || hastyaSvagoKaroShTrANAM karIShairdagdhapUritam ’ iti kUpasvedaH | ayaM coShmasvedaBeda eva kUpasvedaH ||12||
atha holAkasvedamAha - ‘vItikAM tu karIShANAM yathoktAnAM pradIpayet | SayanAntaH pramANena SayyAmupari tatra ca | sudagdhAyAM vidhUmAyAM yathoktAmupakalpayet | svavacCannAM svayaM tasyAM svoktaH svidyati mAnavaH || holAkasveda ityeSha suKaH prokto maharShiNA’ iti | vItikA kumArikA holAsa~jj~jitaH svedaH holAsvedaH | iti holAsvedaH | iti carakoktAstrayodaSasvedAste caturShu svedAdiShvantarBUtAH | ’rU0

dI0 - atha samyaksnehAvagAhane PalamAha - avagAhane yuktaH sneha ekAntarAdividhinA samyak prayuktaSIlaH | tAdRuSa eva SirAdistarpayan san SarIre balamAdhatte tarpayan dhAtUniti SeShaH | yaduktaM -‘mAtrABistriScatuHpaccaShaTsaptAShTaBirAvrajet | rasAsRu~gmAMsamedosthimajjAdhAtUn yathAkrama’miti | mAtrAyASca prasaMgato lakShaNaM saMKyA ca liKyate | yathA – sPajAUnaH - karAvartaM kuryAttAM sPoTikAyutAm | eShA mAtrA BavedekA sarvatraivaiSha niScayaH | saMKyA yathA - ‘vedanopaSamaH pa~jcaSatasaptaSatAni vA | sahasraM vApi mAtrANAM kuryAddoShabalAbala’mityAdi | SirAmuKai romakUpairiti | SirANAM muKAni romakUpapratibaddhAnIti BAvaH | sirASca doShAdivahA iti granthakAraH sandhibandhanakAriNyo doShAdhAtuvahAH SirA iti | tASca sthUlasUkShmaBedenApi dvidhA Bavanti tAsAM nABimUlatvAdadhastiryak ca prasaraH | tathAhyuktam - 'yAvantyastu sirAH kAye saMBavanti SarIriNAm | nABipravRuddhAH sarvAstAH pratanvanti samantata’ iti | dhamanIBiSceti | dhmAnAdanilApUraNAddhamanyo rasavahAScaturviMSatisaMKyAkAH | etAScApi nABipraBavA aBihitAH | cakArAttAsAmapi muKAni romakUpapratibaddhAni j~jAtavyAni | yataH ye svedamaBivahanti rasaM cABitarpayantyantarbahiSca | taireva cABya~ggapariShekAvagAhAlepanavIryANyantaH SarIramaBipratipadyanta iti ||31 ||

pada:
avagAhanaPalam -
sirAmuKai romakUpairdhamanIBiSca tarpayet || 31 || 
SarIre balamAdhatte yuktaH sneho~avagAhane |

vya_text: gU0 - svedanAtkadA nivRuttirBavati ? ityatrAha - SIta iti | SItaSUlAdInAmuparame nivRutte sati stamBagauravayornigrahe sati, mArdave mRudutve sati dehasyaiva tadA svedanAdviratirnivRuttirmatA || 32-34 ||

dI0 - atha snehAvagAhanAdvAyuvRuddhau satyAM taddRuShTAntenAsya prAdhAnyamAha | mUle pAnIyasiktasya vRukShasya yathA~gkurAH pallavAdirUpA vardhante tadvadatrApi dhAtuvRuddhau boddhavyaM | nAtaH para iti | asmAt snehAvagAhanAt aparo vAtanASako yogo na pradhAna iti BAvaH | atha svedakarmaNo virativiShayamAha - SItaSIlAdyuparame iti | SUlaSAntau satyAM SUlaSabdena vAtAdijanito vedanAsamUho boddhavyaH | stamBo gauravaM cAMgAnAM tayornirgraho nASaH | tasmi~jjAte sati dIptAgnau sati | mArdavamapi a~ggAnAM mRudutA tasminnapi jAte sati viratirviSrAmaH; tena eBiH kAraNaiH svedaguNo~avagantavyaH | tathA hyuktam - 'agnau dIpte mArdavaM tvakprasAdaM BaktaSraddhAM srotasAM nirmalatvam | kuryAtsvedastandranidre ca hanyAt sandhInbandhAMSceShTayedASu yukta’ iti | sauShadhasvedAtiyogalakShaNamuktaM vAgBaTe - 'pittAsrakopatRuNmUrcCAsvarA~ggasadanaBramAH | sandhipIDAjvaraH SyAvaraktamaNDaladarSanam | svedAtiyogAcCardiSca tatra stamBanamauShadham’ iti || 32-34 ||

pada:
dhAtuvardhanamAha -
jalasiktasya vardhante yathAmUle~a~gkurAstaroH || 32 || 
tathA dhAtuvivRuddhirhi snehasiktasya jAyate | 
nAtaH parataraH kaScidupAyo vAtanASanaH || 33 || 
SItaSUlAdyuparame stamBagauravanigrahe |
dIptAgnau mArdave jAte svedanAdviratirmatA || 34 ||

vya_text:
gU0 - svedAnantaraM kiM kuryAdityAha - samyak svinnaM samyak sveditam | punaH vimRuditaM kRutABya~ggam | paScAcCannairuShNAmbunA kuryAditi pUrvakriyAsambandha: | anaBiShyandi sroto rodhi Bojayet | vyAyAmaM SramAdyaM na kArayet | suSrute caturvidhaH navasvedaH kathitaH | cakArAdvAgBaTAdau trayodaSavidhaH | granthaj~jApanArthaM tadapi liKyate | taduktaM vAgBaTe - 'Sa~gkaraH prastaro nADI pariSheko~avagAhanam | jetAko~aSmaGanaH karpU: kuTI, kumBI tathAca BUH || kUpo lohAkaraScaite svedAScaiva trayodaSa’ iti | eShAM lakShaNaM vAgBaTe darSitam || 35 ||
iti SrIkASIrAmavaidyaviracitAyAM SAr~ggadharagUDhArthadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe svedAdhyAyaH || 2 ||

dI0 - vimRuditamiti | snehAvagAhAnantaraM suKamardanam, uShNAmbuBiruShNodakaiH snAnam, anaBiShyandi Bojayet | jATharAgne: saMdIpanArthaM vyAyAmaM SarIrAyAsajanakaM karma | kecit - 'vyAyAmaM na ca kArayet’ ityatra - ‘sarvatrAcAramAcaret’ iti pAThaM paThanti | tatra AcAraH snehAcaraNaM, tacca vAgBaTe~apyuktam - ‘uShNodakopacArI syAdbrahmacArI kShapASayaH | na vegarodhI vyAyAmakrodhaSokahimAtapAn | pravAtayAnayAnAdhvaBAShyAByAsanasaMsthitIH | nIcAtyuccopadhAnAhaHsvapnadhUmarajAMsi ca’ iti || 35 ||
iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaSrIBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe svedAdhyAyo dvitIyaH || 2 ||

pada:
susvinnasya paScAt karma darSayati -
samyak svinnaM vimRuditaM snAnamuShNAmbuBiH SanaiH | 
BojayeccAnaBiShyandi vyAyAmaM na ca kArayet ||35||
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe svedavidhirnAma
dvitIyo~adhyAyaH || 2 ||
